title: Evidence pack: ss-resolve/references/evidence-pack.json
description: Generated by scripts/build-evidence-pack.mjs from the one corpus run named in research/consensus/evidence-pack-run.json; never edited by hand. It carries, per claim, page type, and viewport, how many measured design systems landed in each value bucket, counted by kind (product system or kit), and nothing that identifies page text or a per-system value. Lineage id and name are its only identifiers. Rules the schema cannot express are enforced by normalizeEvidencePack in ss-resolve/scripts/system-proposal.mjs: a value claim has no boolean bucket and a flag claim no numeric one (scripts/lib/evidence-pack.mjs refuses both when it builds); a pack whose schemaVersion is above 1 is refused. Additive changes (new claims, rows, lineages, optional claim fields) keep schemaVersion 1.

touch.description: run.json touch === true; false when the run measured no touch input

lineages.description: Every lineage of the run's manifest with at least one measured screen or fragment, in manifest order

claims.description: One entry per packed claim, in the order the claims first appear in consensus.json: the claim id and its CLAIM_USES line. The proposer ignores a claim whose use or axis it does not know; unknown keys are kept

axis.description: A ledger axis of DECISION_AXES; never accent, ink, canvas, or fonts

use.description: value (a numeric bucket is a candidate value), flag (a true bucket stands for values), or note (a count line)

complete.description: false: the value is one member of a set axis

rows.description: Every row of consensus.json whose claim is packed, in file order

pageType.description: dashboard, list, form, detail, or all (every page type pooled); later runs may add page types

measured.description: Lineages with a value on full screens (mixed included)

buckets.description: The row's distribution, most lineages first
